description: Neblla's STORE (Mundo, the "Tienda" part of the mundo chapter): developers sell 3D things made by people, each sale charged on the author's own Stripe payout account (refunds and disputes are theirs). Kinds: "avatar" (a thing for the person's doll: a cap, a backpack, wings; rigid on one bone), "piece" (a piece for games, like the catalogue's) and, from Templates, "template", "block" and "pack" (blocks, and optionally a template that uses them): sold as their recipe (JSON, "recipe") instead of a file, checked by the format of Templates; no upload. They have numbered versions: "release" { id, recipe, notes?, major? } publishes 1.1 after 1.0 (2.0 with major); buyers take it when they choose, under their own changes, and the documentation (ids, options, variables) is made by itself. A developer may put what they bought in what they sell but not sell it as it is (store_unchanged_copy). Licences (offers, prices in euro cents): "person" (only "avatar": a player buys it and wears it in every Mundo game; at least 100; Neblla keeps 30 %) and "dev" (a developer buys it once, uses it in all their apps and may put it in what they sell; at least 1; Neblla's commission goes from 2 % at 1 € to 10 % at 5 €, 20 % at 20 € and 30 % from 50 €, straight between). Nobody may resell the file itself. The "dev" licence has no minimum price (below 50 cents it is bought in the cart, once Neblla opens it) and may also be priced in pack CREDITS (credits: 14 credits = 1 cent, 14,000 = 10 €): the buyer pays with the credits of their packs (never the daily allowance or Pro's) and you get them as a new pack of six months, minus Neblla's commission in credits; credits never turn into euros and are never refunded. A thing for the doll says where it goes: look { bone (one of Head, neck_01, spine_01, spine_02, spine_03, pelvis, clavicle_l, upperarm_l, lowerarm_l, hand_l, clavicle_r, upperarm_r, lowerarm_r, hand_r, thigh_l, calf_l, foot_l, thigh_r, calf_r, foot_r), at: [x, y, z] metres from the joint in the doll's axes (+y up, +z forward, standard 1.83 m body), turn: [x, y, z] degrees, size }, and may give a power { speed 1-2, jump 1-2, fly } that only counts in games that accept the sandbox. Before it is published every file is checked: weight, triangles and textures (avatar {"bytes":1000000,"triangles":4000,"textures":2,"side":1024,"size":2.5}; piece {"bytes":4000000,"triangles":20000,"textures":4,"side":2048,"size":50}), and a thing for the doll is tried on 5 extreme bodies in the poses rest, run, sit, arms-up, crouch: it may touch the part it rides and the ones next to it, never go into a part further away ("through": which body, pose and bone, how deep) nor float off its part ("detached"). Fix what the report says and upload or update again. Actions: "create" { kind, name, description?, tags?, offers, look?, power? } → a draft; "update" { id, …same fields } (a new look is tried on again); "upload" { id, file (base64) | fileUrl (https) } → the glb, checked; "publish" { id } (needs a passing check, a price, your payout account and an adult seller: the developer says their date of birth once in Neblla Creator; under 18 it is refused with seller_minor, unknown with seller_age_required); "withdraw" { id } (buyers keep it); "release" { id, recipe, notes?, major? } → a new version of a template, a block or a pack; "report" { id, reportKind?: "product" (default) | "piece" (a piece of the catalogue, its id from neblla_assets), reason: sexual | copyright | inappropriate | hate | harassment | spam | illegal | privacy | other, message? (required for "other") } → report something wrong; Neblla reviews every report, sexual content within hours, and the reporter is never shown to the author. A product reported by several people, or once for sexual content, is "suspended" (hidden while Neblla reviews it); "removed" is Neblla's decision: out of the store and worn by nobody, though buyers keep the licence. Until Neblla opens the store it sells in Stripe's test mode (test: true): nothing is charged. The actions that only look (mine, check, get, fee, assets, sanctions) are in neblla_store_read.
